newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-HODDLE CALLS UP BOWYER AS INJURIES MOUNT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HODDLE CALLS UP BOWYER AS INJURIES MOUNT.

text.p: England manager Glenn Hoddle on Thursday called up Leeds midfielder Lee Bowyer as injuries continued to ravage his squad for Saturday's friendly against Mexico.
Matt Le Tissier (foot) and Sol Campbell (leg) have become the latest in an extraordinarily long line of withdrawals.
Centre half Tony Adams, goalkeeper Ian Walker and defender Gary Neville pulled out earlier leaving Hoddle faced with picking virtually a complete reserve team.
The manager has now lost 10 players from his original squad -- with a further six likely choices not even available for consideration. "It's been a big problem,'' said Hoddle.
Bowyer had been named in England's under-21 squad to play Switzerland but now has a good chance of making his senior debut.

The 21-year-old joined Leeds from Charlton last year for 2.6 million pounds ($4.2 million). His previous brush with fame came while at Charlton when he failed a drugs test and had to undergo rehabilitation.
